There are no network requests, downloads, or executions from untrusted sources during the build or install phase.

No obfuscated code, suspicious commands (e.g., `eval`, `base64`, `curl|bash`), or unauthorized file operations are present. The package adheres to standard AUR packaging practices and shows no signs of malicious behavior.
